result.summary: Found two minor visual and content issues relating to text truncation and an illogical badge value.

issues.description: A promotional badge on the pizza item displays a '-0%' discount, which is confusing and serves no purpose.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge if the calculated discount percentage is zero.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' at the edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Implement proper text truncation with ellipsis or wrap the text to a second line.
